scope: ag choices, ag doctor and ag dash over each node's AHP hosts: pi-daemon, its bridge and (optional) Paratenic
authority: Each host's SessionState.inputNeeded is the only choices store (pi-daemon for Durable sessions, the pi-daemon bridge for TUI Pis, Paratenic when it runs); ag keeps no second queue and adds no Pi-side server.

requirements.contract: List input-needed sessions per node via AHP listSessions (paged, bounded) and session snapshots; group by node and agent; actionability mirrors Culture (catalogue, backendOnline/inputAvailable, lifecycle, read-only chat); non-chat inputs are listed with --all but never answered.

Answer with chat/inputCompleted to the request's chat. Re-read the authoritative session first; refuse gone/changed(revision)/unavailable without dispatch; validate answers locally as Paratenic does; settle only on the host echo of our exact clientId/clientSeq (accepted/rejected); missing echo is indeterminate and never retried.
Stable flock-leased logical client ids per host with persisted monotonic clientSeq; reused ids never replay a retained dispatch.
Endpoints come from ag hosts[].paratenic or the Culture host with the same id; ws:// off-loopback needs explicit allow_plaintext_non_loopback; bearer files may be symlinks and are never logged.
Down nodes are reported quietly as offline with a short reason, never hide healthy nodes and do not set exit 3; refused bearer/protocol errors are errors.

Ratatui TUI: keyboard and mouse, keyed selection survives refresh, recommended default, number/Enter answers, multi-select, freeform, double-press decline, multi-question forms visit every question and skip empty optional text, one answer in flight, narrow single-pane layout; terminal raw mode, alternate screen and mouse capture restored on exit.

Concurrent bounded read-only checks per node: ssh/local ag, Paratenic AHP catalogue + /status probe, speech recency and mute, gallery cache freshness. Offline nodes collapse to one line; AHP-up/SSH-down and SSH-up/Paratenic-down are warnings; exit 3 only for errors.

Live server: choices stale-while-revalidate (20s while viewed), per-node refresh after answers, health and image pulls on intervals for the command lifetime; same answer path as CLI/TUI/MCP; duplicate in-flight answers refused.

Per-run token exchanged for HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie on every route; mutations need X-Ag-Dash and same-origin Origin; loopback binds pin Host; gallery serves only index and archive files inside the canonical cache (no traversal, .json or symlink escape) with nosniff and sandboxing CSP; Ctrl-C releases the listener.

Default port 7795. Root and ag subflake export an opt-in Home Manager systemd user service with configurable IPv4/IPv6/wildcard bind IP, public origin, package/config/cache/token paths and refresh intervals. Restarts on failure or exit and starts under default.target; no firewall/Serve/config mutation. Persistent owner-private runtime tokens survive restarts, preserve managed links and are not logged. Public hostname is admitted without disabling Host checks; SIGTERM releases the HTTP listener.
ag_choices_list, ag_doctor and confirmation-gated ag_choices_answer share the CLI domain core.

pi-daemon and its bridge are resolved, listed, answered and health-checked independently of Paratenic: paratenic.enabled=false (or Paratenic not running) leaves them working. Endpoints come from pi-client's client.hosts, else Culture's <node>-pi-daemon and <node>-pi; pi_daemon.enabled / pi_daemon.bridge switch them fleet-wide or per host; the legacy paratenic.pi_daemon=false still turns both off.

ag doctor adds pi-daemon and pi-bridge rows (AHP catalogue: sessions/TUI Pis and waiting; unauthenticated /readyz: version, draining). A bridge without /ahp is a warning naming pi-daemon >= 1.11. Paratenic is optional: omitted when disabled or not configured, shown as '○ … optional' when not running while pi-daemon serves the node; stale Paratenic input-needed sessions (backend gone) are counted apart. A node is offline only when neither SSH nor any AHP host answers.

A node that never archived images or audio (no archive directory) syncs as an empty archive (state synced, last-sync stamped), not an rsync failure or 'not pulled yet'; an unreadable archive still fails and retains the cache.
Every dash answer outcome, including endpoint/connection failures (state failed), is kept in /api/state receipts and logged to the service journal without the answer.

Images and Audio tabs: Pause auto-refresh keeps the framed viewer still until resumed or the page reloads (newer syncs wait with a Load button); per-node sync status starts collapsed and remembers its state in browser storage; search/node/agent filters survive a re-framed newer sync (sessionStorage).
tests: manual Playwright QA against a live local dash (docs/assets/ag/fleet-ahp/review.md)

requirements.contract: dash.access auto (default) needs no token on loopback and Tailscale listeners (100.64.0.0/10, fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48) and requires one on wildcard/LAN binds; open never, token always. In every mode a bound address pins Host (its address, this machine's short and full names, the public origin and its short name), and answers/refreshes need X-Ag-Dash plus a same-origin Origin; an old ?token= link redirects without a cookie.

visual_review.tool: playwright-cli screenshots of ag dash and tmux-captured TUI against cargo run --example fake_paratenic; synthetic data only
findings_fixed: health badge said ok with nodes offline
images freshness stale after a dash pull
rail selection loud while question pane focused

live_observation: Read-only ag doctor/choices list against the operator fleet: healthy Paratenic hosts listed sessions and waiting questions; down nodes were reported offline; two hosts returned a host-side logical client limit error, reported upstream by the operator. No answer was sent to a real agent. 2026-10-22 (ag 0.7): a pi-daemon async_choice on ms-mac answered through the deployed Helsinki dash API and by clicking in Chromium against a local dash; real TUI Pis on ms-mac and aurora answered through their bridges (the agents continued with the answers). A pi-daemon session's image_share and audio_share were archived and listed by ag image/audio list and shown in the dash; pi-daemon sessions on ms-mac and aurora write the node speech feed. Only the agent's own test questions were answered.
